subject: Acceptance dependency recast + MAP patch (Veridian)
messages:
From: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@veridianhealth.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Myers <dana.myers@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft — potential acceptance delay

Hi Naomi,

Quick note from our side — after an internal review this morning we ran a dependency sweep and found two outstanding items that block acceptance: (1) a data retention policy alignment that Legal needs to sign off, and (2) a smaller auth integration that our SSO team needs to validate (token rotation behavior). Those both sit outside the dates we originally captured in the MAP.

We'd like to propose a 10 business-day buffer to the go-live acceptance window to avoid engineering crunch and to let us complete the audit. Can you share what options Redwood has for a phased acceptance (partial feature sign-off) or conditional acceptance tied to a remediation SLA?

Attaching a short risk list we compiled.

Best,
Liam
[Attachment: veridian_initial_risk_scan.pdf (pdf, 130KB)]

From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft — potential acceptance delay

Liam — thanks for the heads up and the clear dependency list. We can accommodate a phased acceptance model but we need to align on the exact acceptance criteria per phase so billing/credits and SLA triggers are deterministic.

Proposed next steps:
- We (Redwood) will run a short dependency remediation plan and produce a MAP patch that enumerates which items are "Phase A" (core API + embeddings) vs "Phase B" (SSO token rotation, extended retention).
- Camila will owner a refreshed acceptance matrix and Ben will scope the conditional SLA language for remediation SLAs/credits.
- Naomi will coordinate procurement touchpoints so the contract reflects conditional acceptance and any temporary credits.

I'll circulate a MAP_patch_v1.3 with an updated timeline and a risk log by EOD tomorrow. If you can confirm whether Legal needs evidence (SOC2 artifact or retention appendix) we can include that in the packet.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_MAP_patch_outline.txt (text, 3KB)]

From: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acceptance matrix + timeline recast (draft)

Team / Liam — draft acceptance matrix attached below (see also Drive link). Key changes from the original MAP:

- Split acceptance into Phase A (API functionality, embeddings quality, latency SLOs) and Phase B (SSO token rotation, retention appendix approval).
- Phase A target: 2026-03-12 (unchanged) but with a hard testing window 2026-03-08 -> 2026-03-11 for validation. Failure in the window will trigger the Phase A remediation SLA.
- Phase B target: 2026-03-26 (moved +10 business days) to allow Legal and SSO validation.
- Conditional credit: if Phase B acceptance misses the 2026-03-26 date without a mutually-agreed extension, Redwood offers a one-time credit equal to 5% monthly run-rate for the first month post-go-live.

Open questions for Veridian:
1) Can your SSO team commit a validation slot between 3/8–3/11?
2) Does Legal require the SOC2 retention appendix or will a signed attestation suffice?

I pushed a working spreadsheet: veridian_risk_log_v2.xlsx (see attachment). I scoped risk severity and owner per row; please update ownership where needed.

Camila
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: veridian_risk_log_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 240KB)]

From: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@veridianhealth.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Myers <dana.myers@veridianhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 07:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acceptance matrix + timeline recast (draft)

Camila / Naomi — thanks for the quick turnaround. We can tentatively reserve SSO validation on 3/9 but I need to lock in our Identity lead. Legal says a signed attestation plus the retention appendix draft is acceptable for initial Phase A acceptance; they want the final retention appendix signed before Phase B acceptance.

Procurement: we will need the MAP patch and conditional credit language in the contract addendum to table at our side. Please advise if Redwood can provide a single-page addendum for faster signature.

Liam

To: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@veridianhealth.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acceptance matrix + timeline recast (draft) — contract addendum and escalation note

Liam / Veridian procurement — copying Laura from Legal at Redwood.

Ben here — attaching a one-page addendum template that embeds the Phase A/Phase B definitions, the conditional credit (5% one-time as Camila proposed), and the remediation SLA triggers. We recommend the following escalation path if Phase B acceptance slips beyond 3/26 without a mutually-signed extension:

- Week 0–1 post-miss: automatic daily check-ins (owner-level) and a joint triage call within 48h.
- Week 2 post-miss: Redwood to open prioritized engineering lane and provide weekly progress notes; Veridian can request an independent acceptance observer.
- Week 4 post-miss: right to propose staggered go-live (feature gating) or request contract credit governance review.

Attachment: MAP_patch_v1.3.pdf (contains the addendum + updated timeline). If Procurement needs a signature-ready DocuSign link we can push that today.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_patch_v1.3.pdf (pdf, 420KB)]
